'''Corinna Salander''' (1967) is a German physicist and engineer who has been serving as director of the [[German Centre for Rail Traffic Research]] (DZSF) since 2020.<ref name="headofdzsf">{{cite news |title=Corinna Salander Becomes Head of the DZSF |url=https://railway-news.com/corinna-salander-dzsf/ |access-date=22 November 2021 |work=Railway-News |date=14 October 2019}}</ref><ref name="cv">{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr.-Ing. Corinna Salander |url=https://www.ksb.com/de-global/investor-relations/corporate-governance/struktur-management/corinna-salander |website=www.ksb.com |access-date=22 November 2021}}</ref>

==Career==

She studied physics from 1987 to 1993 at [[University of Kiel]].<ref name="cv"/> She received a PhD in [[electrical engineering]] from [[Clausthal University of Technology]] in 1999.<ref name="cv"/> Her dissertation was on algorithms for the calculation of electromagnetic fields in rail vehicles.<ref name=abiturst>{{cite news |title=Prof. Dr. Corinna Salander auf neue Stiftungsprofessur Schienenfahrzeugtechnik berufen |url=https://www.abitur-und-studium.de/Blogs/Universitaet-Stuttgart/Prof-Dr-Corinna-Salander-auf-neue-Stiftungsprofessur-Schienenfahrzeugtechnik-berufen |access-date=7 July 2022 |work=www.abitur-und-studium.de |language=de-DE}}</ref> From 1999 to 2014, she held multiple executive positions at [[Deutsche Bahn]], [[European Union Agency for Railways]] and [[Bombardier Inc.|Bombardier]].<ref name="cv"/> She held a chair in rail vehicle technology ({{langx|de|Schienenfahrzeugtechnik}}) at the [[University of Stuttgart]] from 2014 to 2019.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Germany |first1=Stuttgarter Zeitung, Stuttgart |title=MINT: Erfolgreiche Frauen als Vorbilder |url=https://www.stuttgarter-zeitung.de/inhalt.mint-erfolgreiche-frauen-als-vorbilder.a0e4702a-3fea-44a4-afdd-bc85c9d0b104.html |access-date=22 November 2021 |work=stuttgarter-zeitung.de |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr.-Ing. Corinna Salander {{!}} Institut für Maschinenelemente {{!}} Universität Stuttgart |url=https://www.ima.uni-stuttgart.de/institut/team/Salander/ |website=www.ima.uni-stuttgart.de |access-date=22 November 2021}}</ref> She was the first female European professor in railway transport technology.<ref name=abiturst/> The chair was supported by [[Knorr Bremse]] und Voith Turbo GmbH.<ref name=abiturst/>

She gave multiple interviews about [[DZSF]] and railway transport technology to regular magazines and newspapers, for instance, Eurailpress in October 2020, to [[Die Zeit]] in Juni 2021 and to System||Bahn, a German railway magazine, in December 2021.<ref>{{cite news |title=Prof. Dr.-Ing. Corinna Salander: Wissenschaft und Politikberatung |url=https://www.eurailpress.de/nachrichten/personen-positionen/detail/news/prof-dr-ing-corinna-salander-wissenschaft-und-politikberatung.html |access-date=7 July 2022 |work=www.eurailpress.de |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Tschepke |first1=Thomas |title="Beim Thema Nachwuchs sollte die Bahnbranche zusammenhalten" |url=https://www.system-bahn.net/aktuell/beim-thema-nachwuchs-sollte-die-bahnbranche-zusammenhalten/ |access-date=7 July 2022 |work=System{{!}}{{!}}Bahn |date=10 December 2021 |language=de-DE}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=ZEIT ONLINE {{!}} Lesen Sie zeit.de mit Werbung oder im PUR-Abo. Sie haben die Wahl. |url=https://www.zeit.de/news/2021-06/30/fitnessstudio-im-zug-wie-die-verkehrswende-gelingen-soll |access-date=7 July 2022 |work=www.zeit.de}}</ref>

==Life==
She is married and a mother of three children.<ref>{{cite web |title=DZSF - Die Leitung |url=https://www.dzsf.bund.de/DZSF/DE/DasDZSF/Aufbau_Organisation/Die_Leitung/die_Leitung_node.html |website=www.dzsf.bund.de |access-date=22 November 2021}}</ref>

In 2018, she participated as one of the four expert in the ''Tübinger Achtbar''.<ref name=tubing>{{cite news |title=Die Vorbilder von morgen |url=https://www.tagblatt.de/Nachrichten/Die-Vorbilder-von-morgen-395992.html |access-date=7 July 2022 |work=Schwäbisches Tagblatt |language=de}}</ref> According to Prof. Corinna Salander, the fact that the majority of German women currently do not take up scientific and technical professions is at least partly due to their own comfort.<ref name=tubing/> Together with Saskia Schulz, Prof. Markus Hecht und Annette Hering, she participated in MINTeinander-Konferenz about the [[gender diversity]] issue.<ref>{{cite news |title=MINTeinander-Konferenz: Frauen und Technik sind das perfekte Paar |url=https://www.heringinternational.com/de/news/artikel/n/minteinander-konferenz-frauen-und-technik-sind-das-perfekte-paar/ |access-date=7 July 2022 |work=www.heringinternational.com |language=de}}</ref> In Mai 2022, she participated in a [[F.A.Z.]]-podcast ''Women and men do not fit together'' with her husband Volker Looman.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Zeitung |first1=Frankfurter Allgemeine |title=Frauen und Männer passen nicht zusammen |url=https://fazfinanzen.podigee.io/61-neue-episode |access-date=7 July 2022 |work=FAZ Finanzen & Immobilien |language=de}}</ref>

==Awards (selection)==
On 29 October 2021, she became an awardee of the Golden environmental rail ({{langx|de|Goldene Umweltschiene}}).<ref>{{cite news |title=BUNDESVERBAND FÜHRUNGSKRÄFTE DEUTSCHER BAHNEN E. V. - Goldene Umweltschiene |url=https://www.bfbahnen.de/presse/goldene-umweltschiene.html |access-date=22 November 2021 |work=www.bfbahnen.de}}</ref>
